Failure mode / cause: CF1 Person inside the exclusion zone or the arms' reach (crew, observer or bystander)
Effect: Person struck, crushed or pinned by an arm, claw or end effector

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Arms not stowed and locked while walking: in the CL-05 layout the hanging claws reach 0.85 m above the ground beside the legs, inside the walking envelope
Effect: Person struck, crushed or pinned by an arm, claw or end effector

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Manipulation commanded or not inhibited while walking or while the exclusion zone is not confirmed clear
Effect: Person struck, crushed or pinned by an arm, claw or end effector

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Inertial loads from the gait, slope or uneven ground act on the load
Effect: Load falls on or strikes a person beside the walker; Load shift moves the centre of mass ahead of the stance foot and contributes to a fall (HAZ-WLK-002)

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Grip or securing failure, or the arms leave the carry pose
Effect: Load falls on or strikes a person beside the walker; Load shift moves the centre of mass ahead of the stance foot and contributes to a fall (HAZ-WLK-002)

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Load mass, centre of gravity, speed, step height or slope beyond the loaded limits
Effect: Load falls on or strikes a person beside the walker; Load shift moves the centre of mass ahead of the stance foot and contributes to a fall (HAZ-WLK-002)

Failure mode / cause: CF4 Loaded walking enabled without confirmed securing, carry pose and load limits
Effect: Load falls on or strikes a person beside the walker; Load shift moves the centre of mass ahead of the stance foot and contributes to a fall (HAZ-WLK-002)

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Motion-enable logic enables actuation before readiness conditions are met
Effect: Pilot or crew caught between moving leg/chassis structure

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Valve or drive fault produces motion with enable removed
Effect: Pilot or crew caught between moving leg/chassis structure

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Pilot inadvertently deflects a control while entering
Effect: Pilot or crew caught between moving leg/chassis structure

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Loss of actuator supply (hydraulic line burst or bus loss) together with load-holding valves or brakes that fail to engage (latent failure)
Effect: Cockpit strikes its rest stops at about 4.8 m/s after a 1.2 m fall (simulation SF-01 EC-01, synthetic)

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Load holding engages, but slower than the cockpit falls from operating height (engagement delay longer than the free-fall time)
Effect: Cockpit strikes its rest stops at about 4.8 m/s after a 1.2 m fall (simulation SF-01 EC-01, synthetic)

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Leg actuator, supply or load-holding fault prevents lowering
Effect: Pilot remains at height; leaving needs the side-hatch emergency exit

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Lowering inhibited by a fault response or a stuck interlock
Effect: Pilot remains at height; leaving needs the side-hatch emergency exit

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Terrain or slope does not allow the kneel posture
Effect: Pilot remains at height; leaving needs the side-hatch emergency exit

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Stop supervisor commands an unsafe trajectory or zero torque in a loaded pose
Effect: Uncontrolled motion or collapse of walker or payload

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Loss of hydraulic or electrical power during the stop
Effect: Uncontrolled motion or collapse of walker or payload

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Stop request not received over the pilot or observer link
Effect: Uncontrolled motion or collapse of walker or payload

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Sensor, connector or bus failure
Effect: Joint runaway, loss of balance

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Monitor fails to detect stale data or detection is too slow
Effect: Joint runaway, loss of balance

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Locomotion controller acts on stale state
Effect: Joint runaway, loss of balance

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Balance controller fails to recover or commands an unstable gait
Effect: Overturn or fall of the platform
Mitigations: M1(b) M2(c) M3(c) M4(d) M5(c) M6(b) M7(c)

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Terrain gives way or slope exceeds envelope
Effect: Overturn or fall of the platform
Mitigations: M1(b) M2(c) M3(c) M4(d) M5(c) M6(b) M7(c)

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Pilot commands manoeuvre or payload beyond limits
Effect: Overturn or fall of the platform
Mitigations: M1(b) M2(c) M3(c) M4(d) M5(c) M6(b) M7(c)

Failure mode / cause: CF4 Loss of actuator supply (hydraulic pressure or bus voltage) shrinks the balance capacity before load holding engages; a slow leak on a slope tips the walker, and a hold that engages with the capture point outside the foot tips it too (simulation SF-01 EC-07 and EC-08 at level 1; at level 2 with the adopted torques EC-07 drops the cockpit instead and EC-08 tips only with the ankle at or below about 12 kN m; sizing SZ-01; synthetic)
Effect: Overturn or fall of the platform
Mitigations: M1(b) M2(c) M3(c) M4(d) M5(c) M6(b) M7(c)

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Crew member or bystander inside the folding zone of the pod and legs
Effect: Person pinned by the descending pod or folding legs

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Kneel or rise commanded without a confirmed clear zone
Effect: Person pinned by the descending pod or folding legs

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Uncontrolled descent while lowering (loss of actuator supply or load holding)
Effect: Person pinned by the descending pod or folding legs
